description: Finite canonical reference images used to certify assignment-induced tracking-coordinate resets before policy execution.

SAT-COV-V1.interpretation: The canonical normalized attitude-reference reset changes only the three angle coordinates. Angular-rate reference components are continuous at episode boundaries.

UAV-AG-V1.interpretation: The canonical normalized waypoint-reference reset changes only the two planar position coordinates. Velocity reference components are continuous at episode boundaries.
